# Envoy Appoints Mauricio Ramirez as Chief Revenue Officer to Accelerate Global Growth

Envoy appoints Mauricio Ramirez, previously of Verkada, as Chief Revenue Officer to lead global sales, account management, and channel partnerships.

![Envoy Appoints Mauricio Ramirez as Chief Revenue Officer to Accelerate Global Growth](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6509fe179d7033a278a05268/699e4d18cd313df7b66754a3_CRO-Social-Envoy-260217_LinkedIn.webp)

**San Francisco, CA — February 26, 2026** — [Envoy](https://envoy.com/), a workplace technology company that makes it simple to run secure, compliant and connected workplaces across every location, has announced the appointment of Mauricio Ramirez as Chief Revenue Officer (CRO). Mauricio will oversee Envoy’s global go-to-market strategy, leading the company’s sales, account management, and channel partnership teams as Envoy continues to redefine the modern, secure workplace.

With over 20 years of experience in enterprise technology and a proven track record of scaling high-growth revenue organizations, Mauricio joins Envoy at a pivotal moment. As companies prioritize physical security and integrated workplace management, he will focus on expanding Envoy's global footprint and deepening its relationships with enterprise customers.

“Envoy exists to make workplaces safer and easier to run,” said Larry Gadea, Founder and CEO of Envoy. “Mauricio knows what it takes to build security products that earn trust—at scale. He’s obsessive about customers and outcomes, and that’s exactly what we need as more companies turn to Envoy to protect their people and their spaces.”

Mauricio brings a wealth of specialized knowledge in the security sector, which aligns directly with Envoy’s mission to provide enterprise-grade safety and compliance through its product suite. He most recently served as Vice President of North American Enterprise Sales at Verkada, where he led teams across the U.S. and Canada to modernize physical security through cloud-based hardware and software.

"Envoy has a unique opportunity to become _the_ operating system for the modern workplace," said Mauricio Ramirez, CRO of Envoy. "The company’s focus on securing the places the world relies on most resonates deeply with my background. I am thrilled to join this talented team and look forward to driving sustainable growth by helping our customers create safer, more efficient, and more connected workplace experiences."

Prior to Verkada, Mauricio was Senior Vice President of Global Strategic Sales at Conga, where he spearheaded global sales operations. He has also held senior leadership positions at Amplitude, Informatica, BEA Systems, and Oracle.

To learn more about Envoy and how it’s shaping the future of work, or to join the team, visit [envoy.com](https://envoy.com/).

## **About Envoy**

[Envoy](https://envoy.com/) protects the places the world relies on most by unifying people, spaces, and communications in one platform for physical security, safety, and compliance.

More than 16,000 workplaces across 170 countries, including 92 of the Fortune 500, trust Envoy to control and prove who gets into their spaces, from global enterprises to defense and aerospace contractors, semiconductor fabs, manufacturers, data centers, life sciences labs, and healthcare facilities. Envoy unites visitor management, identity verification, screening and governed approvals, real-time presence, workplace reservations, threat intelligence and emergency management in one system of record.

With over 200 integrations across access control, identity, and compliance tools, Envoy helps security, IT, and compliance teams reduce risk, keep operations running smoothly, and stay audit-ready.
